scenario_name: Developer statements (no annual energy figure published)
onsite_generation: None proposed; 500MW BESS for storage/backup, not generation
demand_flexibility: Developer states BESS will charge on off-peak/curtailed renewable electricity and discharge at peak, providing backup and reducing reliance on the grid
notes: Campus would draw power from the national grid with a stated focus on using curtailed renewable electricity; no PUE, load factor, PPA, or annual GWh figures disclosed. Foxglove counts the site at 300MW within its 2,000-3,000MW total for planned Scottish data centres.
